pages: Hey, {NAME}? That thing down at the bottom of the crater...
Isn't that the Animus Bell we saw in Izumo?
If it is... Hm?
That big ornament down there...
Could it be the Animus Bell Master Nicotine told us about?
...Oh? Is someone over there...?
{NAME}! That's the Animus Bell! But we can't reach it down in the crater.
Hm? An intruder?!
...{NAME}, do you see it?
That is the Animus Bell Master Nicotine spoke of...
So it fell all the way from Izumo into this crater...
But to destroy it, we must first get down there...
Hm? Who goes there?
That thing the demons are guarding... is that the so-called Animus Bell?
I'd smash it to bits, but there's no way down to the crater floor.
Honestly, this Mizuki is more trouble than she's worth.
...Hm? Who's there!
Hey, hey, {NAME}!
...Isn't that the thing Grandpa told us to break?
The Animus Bell, right?
Huh? There's somebody there! Look, over there!
...{NAME}.
Is that not the Animus Bell Master Nicotine ordered us to destroy?
But why would it be in such a place...
Hm? Who goes there!
Hmm... So that would be the Animus Bell...
A fine stroke of luck to find it so soon, but getting down into the crater...
...will be no easy feat.
Hmm? And who might that fellow be?
Hey... isn't that the thing old man Nicotine told us about?
The Animus Bell?
...Huh, what? There's someone down there!
Oh, whatever... Let's just get out of this crater!
We'll figure out how to get down there after that!
Let's climb back up for now...
Somehow we have to reach the place where the Animus Bell is.
...Well, there's no point in staying here.
Let's head up to the summit and figure out how to get down there!
Cough...
Nothing good will come of lingering in such foul air.
Let us climb back up for now...
...and think again about how to reach the crater floor.
...Tch. Very well.
I'll get out of this crater for now.
...Maybe I'll find some way down to the bottom.
Argh! I don't get it anymore!
Let's just get outta here!
Staying here won't get us down to the bottom!
And she wishes to forgive even Lord Amakusa.
For that, what is needed is your strength...
With your strength, please... save Lord Amakusa...
...I wonder when the Seven Realms Sage will show up...
Well done finding this place.
...Known only to a select few, this is Aso's hidden inn.
That was quite an earthquake! Heaven help us...
But if I was scared of a few quakes...
...I couldn't keep this hidden inn going like my forefathers did!
Now, please rest from your travels...
I see. But please don't overdo it.
I hate to be cold about it, but you don't have enough money...
It's dangerous out there lately. Please be careful!
I'm gonna take over from my dad...
...and become a great hidden inn manager too!
I am the mysterious item dealer... a seeker of love and truth...
Heh... I figured you'd croaked long ago.
But you put up more of a fight than these worthless demons here...
Is that it?
So... fast... Lord Ha... on...
A sword! Not bad...
...You're no ordinary person, are you?
...are you?
But...
...is it?!
...and my work was all done, too!
...or I'll eat you up!
Move left / leave it
You came for Yuzawa-en too, traveler?
Yuzawa-en's closed for now. The hot water stopped flowing.
Know any other good hot springs around?
What's that?
The demons were why the water stopped?
And you lot beat them?
Whoa, I'm impressed!
You another tourist here for Yuzawa-en...?
It was closed, wasn't it...?
Just between us, it's not only that the water stopped.
There's a demon in Yuzawa-en right now! I saw it!
A huge demon, stomping around in the hot spring...
Huh?
How do I know about the demon...?
Hehehe...
That's my secret!
You beat the demon? Thanks!
Now if only the hot water came back...
Not that I'm planning to bathe in it, mind you...
What was that white shadow just now?
A whoosh of wind and the pretty sound of a bell...
Well, look at you in white there...
Ain't I seen you somewhere before...?
Can't play outside town, so we play inside.
Us kids got our own troubles, y'know.
You smell like soap...
A hot spring trip in times like these? I'm jealous.
Somethin's goin' on over at Yuzawa-en!
Folks say a demon showed up!
What's that?
The demons were why the water stopped?
And you beat them?
Whoaaa... You must be really strong!
You beat the demon and got the hot water flowing again...
That was you?
Now Yuzawa-en's back to normal! My daily routine is back on!
The water! The water! The hot water's gushing out again!
Well? Did you like it?
Spirit was restored a little!
Ever heard of Rock-Sliding Soap? It's a Beppu specialty!
They say it's used for digging hot springs, but...
Go ask the old lady at Inagaki Temple!
How about it... some shaved ice! Want some?
Just 50GP!
1632.question: Buy shaved ice?

pages: With shaved ice on hand, you'll be fine in a pinch!
No money, no shaved ice. Simple as that.
Tasty, eh? Come again.
Health was restored a little!
Northwest of Beppu there's a place called Monkey Mountain...
Long ago some greedy fool said he'd strike a hot spring...
...and dug a tunnel all the way toward Aso's crater.
What an idiot, huh?
What... what am I supposed to do...
Ooooh! It's just as Lord Haon said!
This cave really does connect Aso to Beppu!
It's all thanks to that tunnel the stupid humans dug...
...and the power of this Rock-Sliding Soap! Meki!
Just like thiiis... slide the rock...
Mekikikiki... now then...
All I have to do is slide that rock in the cave nice and smooth...
...and Kyushu becomes a sea of fire! Bye-bye, Beppu! Mekiki!
Stupid humans, with no idea what fate awaits them...
Mekiki... this is bad...
Without the Rock-Sliding Soap, Lord Haon's plan will...
How could the great Mekira make such a blunder! Meki!
Kyaaaaaaah!
Pervert!
Blasted demons...
Tch... of all places, a hot spring...
No choice, then.
Oh my... Shikuruu? It's Shikuruu!
Mamahaha! It's you, Mamahaha!
Did you fly all the way from Kamuy Kotan?
Hehe... it's been a while!
Sounds like a fuss outside... I wonder what happened...
Hey, hey, didja know?
That strange rock on Monkey Mountain is the lid to a cave!
The hole from when they were digging for hot springs ages ago...
...is still there!
If they made it a date spot, it'd be sooo romantic!
...if only.
Wh... what's going on?! That came from Yuzawa-en!
Up ahead there's a temple and a blacksmith.
No hot water at Yuzawa-en...
What?
No water, but a monster came out?
Eeeek?!
Something's going on over at Yuzawa-en...?
Wanted to wash off the grime before settin' sail, but...
Been hearin' nothin' but bad rumors lately.
At least let me have a nice long soak in the bath.
Sure am glad I can take a bath again, but...
Seems Izumo got torn up somethin' fierce by demons...
...so the authorities went and banned ships from leavin' port...
Got nothin' to do, so I'm in the bath every day.
Come on back anytime.
This oughta do ya.
That person all right?
How much trainin' ya want?
Right, leave it to me!
What'll it be?
Anythin' else ya need?
What're ya buyin'?
Nobody can equip that.
Gonna equip it?
Who's equippin' it?
Which one ya takin' off?
Your money's full up.
Ya got nothin' to sell.
That all right?
Huh...
So that monster Mekira was after this soap...
Has it got something to do with us stopping Aso's eruption?
Right! Kid, leave the demon hunting to the great Haohmaru!
...But why would a demon want soap?
Surely it didn't come to bathe in the hot springs...
Could it be connected to the eruption of Aso the demons planned?
Hehe... oh, never mind.
Little one, don't worry about the demons anymore.
We'll take care of them.
Strange soap, huh...?
That demon was saying something about Aso erupting...
You think it's connected to this?
...Anyway, BOY...
Leave the bad demons to me!
I'll teach them a lesson, no problem!
Cough... demons and soap make an odd pairing, but...
From the way the demon spoke, to make Aso erupt...
...this soap must surely play some part.
...Thank you, little one.
...Leave the demons to us.
Oho! Splendid! The god Tenjin's mighty pleased!
Well done!
I reckon ye'll surely accomplish great things!
Don't let it trouble ye.
Get stronger and come train here again.
Yer trainin' here is done.
Ye're a full-fledged warrior now.
Uh... um...
Well done... finding... this place?
...Known only to... huh? Wait?
Known only to a select few... this is Aso's hidden inn!
...it is.
P-please be careful!
...Phewww... I was so nervous...
My son has taken over from me...
...as the 128th manager of Aso's hidden inn.
He's still green, so please go easy on him.
Hmm... you desire items, do you not?
No, no, no need to hide it... I can tell...
Those folks who went to check out the crater sure have it rough...
We're lookin' into the fireball that fell on Aso.
...But you know what?
Aside from demons runnin' wild, nothin' much is outta the ordinary.
I wanna finish this job quick and soak in a hot spring!
Yuzawa-en in Beppu would be nice!
Beppu's to the east, round the far side of Mount Aso.
The authorities are so fussy lately...
A few demons stir things up and they start shakin' in their boots...
A true Kyushu man stays calm and steady!
Steady as a rock!
I came 'cause I heard there's a legendary hidden inn round here.
...Hm? Don't go sayin' such things!
I ain't tryin' to slack off!
This is a nap! A nap!
Headed to Beppu?
Demons are crawlin' all over lately, so be careful.
Beppu's on the east side of Kyushu, but it's a ways off.
Best get yourself ready.
Oh! Long time no see, little lady.
Sister... I won't ask you to take me along anymore!
Protect nature with your own hands, Sister!
I'll be waiting! Promise you'll come back!
...What's this?!
It's the rock those Lord Ambra fanatics worshipped...
It looks just like... an egg... An egg? No way?
NO! It's the symbol of Lord Ambra! No thank you!
But why would it be here... Could it be... the real thing?
Whoa! This looks like something!
It's the rock the Lord Ambra people were praying to!
Pak Pak, isn't this an egg? ...This egg is alive!
This is...?! Lord Ambra's stone...
No, I can sense it... an intense wave of evil...
It's an egg! The egg of Lord Ambra himself!
What is this...?!
It seems to be the rock the Ambra fanatics worshipped...
As I recall, the Ambra cult teaches that their god is born from an egg...
The egg of Lord Ambra... Is it to be born from here?!
Amakusa! Amakusa's power!
We gotta do something about this power!
Go on! Dance in my place!
Amakusa, beat him!
Give it back! Give back the Palenque Stone!
Then I'll forgive you, 'cause the darkness is controlling you!
...You... Ushiwaka?!
You... Ushiwaka?!
Wow! A skull?
Did that light want to show me this?
Wha, what's this? What is it?
Huh...? It's a skeleton...
A small room in a place like this...?
Oh!
A skull... a human skull...
But why would it be here?
What is this! Human bones...?
Hmph... what, is there something special about it...
Hm... something on the pedestal...
A skull... and a small one at that...
A child's, or a woman's... but why...
Amakusa... When I think of it, he was a sad man...
Oh, Haohmaru... So you've struck down Amakusa!
Ohh, Lady Cham Cham... You have defeated Amakusa?
Wh-what has happened?!
It vanished into the depths of the mansion... Does it want me to go there?
...Huh?
That's weird... this can't be...
One more time! Give me one more chance!
GO! There's no time to hesitate!
Go! Stop Amakusa!
Guhaa! This is the end!
SHIT!
Mere humans, getting cocky... I won't let you interfere with Lord Amakusa!
Heh... so we're surrounded, huh...
Awfully calm, aren't you... Now, go to Hell!
Gwaaaah!
Whoa!
What happened?!
Grrr... who goes there!
What? More humans?!
B-but...
There's no time! Now, go!
...OK, Hanzo...
Wait for me! I'll be back as soon as I'm done!
...Galford.
In this battle, you seem to have grasped something.
I chose to bet on you.
I felt that you could do more than simply fight and defeat Amakusa Shiro...
...that you could accomplish more than that...
Now go... Shinzo... I'm counting on you!
Kukukukuku... You fools...
Still, I shall praise your courage in defying me.
Now, the vengeance begins!
I shall utterly destroy the hated Tokugawa, and on this filthy earth...
...build a hellish paradise ruled by the Dark Lord!
Fuhahahahaha! I will slaughter you all!
Hohohohoho!
This is what happens when I get serious!
Maggots like you merely entering Lord Amakusa's sight...
...is more than I can bear!
You shan't die easily! I'll torment you slowly...
...until you beg me for death!
I am Akaboko, of the red mole...
For 200GP per person, I will fully restore your health and spirit...
1728.question: Full restore?

pages: The castle's falling?!
Everyone, grab onto something! Anything!
We're falling?! This place?!
The sky castle has lost its magic and is falling!
The castle's falling?! SHIT!
Everyone, calm down! Brace for impact!
The sky castle... is falling... Kei...
The castle's falling? Honestly, right to the very end!
Anything else you need?
Is this person all right?
How much training would you like?
Right, wait just a moment.
Mm, looking good!
How may I help you?
Take your pick!
No one can equip this, though.
Who will equip it?
Which one will you remove?
We finally did it!
We beat Mizuki! We beat Mizuki!
...Wh... where am I... What am I...
Y-yes... I remember now...
I fought that demon called Xibalba...
And then... then... Mizuki...
Ugh... my head feels like it's splitting...
I AM TAM TAM. WARRIOR OF GREENHELL...
WHAT YOU DOING IN SACRED TEMPLE...?
I am Sieger... knight of the Drache Reich...
Sieger...? You say SIEGER?!
I'm so glad you're better, Sieger...
Mm... Cham Cham.
It's all thanks to the care of you, your brother, and everyone...
Thank you, truly.
Hehehe...
You're the hero who saved our village, Sieger!
This is the least we could do!
If my soul was able to return from the demon realm...
...then Mizuki must be destroyed, and her hold on me broken...
...is that not so?
But now that the Demon Road is closed...
...how am I to return to my homeland...
Sieger...
Ah... hero from a foreign land, you seem fully recovered.
I am most grateful... This is all thanks to you.
Still, this Super Green Juice works wonders...
I feel even stronger than before.
Is that so...
If there is anything else you wish, we shall grant it.
If anything, I should be the one thanking you...
But I shall accept your kind offer.
Please tell me the way to a port with ships to my homeland.
...Hero, that is the one thing we cannot do.
Greenhell is cut off from the outside world, untouched by it.
There is no way out, and none from outside can enter.
...I see... It cannot be helped.
I will follow the river down and search for a port.
Thank you for everything.
S-Sieger, that's crazy...
Back home, my wife and my knights must be praying for my safety.
I want to show them I'm alive as soon as I can.
I UNDERSTAND, HERO. FOLLOW TAM TAM.
OUR GREAT GOD, LORD QUETZALCOATL!
ANSWER VOICE OF WARRIOR TAM TAM!
Warrior Tam Tam... What do you ask of me...
FOREIGN HERO CANNOT GO HOME. HE IN TROUBLE.
PLEASE USE YOUR GREAT POWER. SEND HERO HOME...
Very well...
That hero is a true warrior who protected my temple from demons.
Warrior Tam Tam, your wish is granted...
GREAT QUETZALCOATL! I GIVE THANKS FROM HEART!
I am grateful for the offer, but I must decline.
Wh-why not?
I am a knight sworn to the Emperor of the Drache Reich...
However kind the offer, I cannot accept the help...
...of a foreign god.
Please don't think ill of me...
Forgive me...
Then let us put it this way...
Hero, it was we who nursed you back to health.
So would you grant us a wish in return?
If it is within my power, gladly...
Then, as thanks...
...take Cham Cham with you to your homeland...
...and show her around a bit, would you?
That way, you are not accepting help.
For we will be using Lord Quetzalcoatl's power...
...to send Cham Cham, you see.
What do you say? I think it is not a bad deal.
